data.name: SPEARPOINT - Delta Unit 7
data.detailed_description:
• SPEARPOINT - Delta Unit 7 is a solo-developed old-school military FPS inspired by the Tactical Shooters of the late 90's and early 2000's. Set in that same period, it borrows the aesthetics of the still analogue warfare of the era to deliver a down-to-earth FPS experience. 

    Straightforward gameplay and streamlined mission structure make it approachable to any and all FPS players. Pick your weapon, mission and engage.

  • NOT QUITE A MILSIM
    Gamefeel was tailored to a comfortable middle ground, making away with the complexities of modern milsims, but also avoiding the common tropes of fast paced 'boomer shooters'. No wall-running, forced stealth or crouch sliding, just point and shoot. 

  • LOOK & FEEL
    Lots of care was put into emulating the look of early 3D PC games as authentically as possible. Low poly graphics and carefully composed low res textures work together to deliver a cohesive aesthetic.

  • IMMERSIVE MISSION DESIGN
    No radar, mini-maps or HUD waypoints. Navigate solely by landmarks, reference points and aerial photos. Take your time, plan your attacks and plot your route.

  • REAL WORLD, ALTERNATE HISTORY
    Minimal story told by non-intrusive means sets the background for each mission.

data.short_description: SPEARPOINT - Delta Unit 7 is a no-frills FPS inspired by the early tactical shooters of the late 90's. Engage in long range battles across varied and expansive landscapes, complete objectives and exfil.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100 / Ryzen 3 1200 / equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB MB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 750 Ti / RX 550 / Intel UHD 630
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit
  • Processor: i5-10400 / Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1650 / RTX 3050 / RX 6600 equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game includes shooting and depictions of warfare.

Shooting an enemy will briefly show a blood splatter effect and lead to death.
